newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Zhonghao to build houses for Hong Kong people.
newsitem.headline: Zhonghao to build houses for Hong Kong people.

text.p: Shenzhen Zhonghao Group Co Ltd plans to construct residential buildings in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone for Hong Kong citizens, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The spokesman told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter that Zhonghao is seeking a 80,000-sq-metre site for the project, which will require a total investment of about three billion yuan.
The project has been approved by the Ministry of Construction and is being supported by the Shenzhen city government, he said.

The houses would be sold only to Hong Kong citizens and the project is part of the Shenzhen government's plan to strengthen links between the territory and Shenzhen after it reverts to China in mid-1997, he added.
Zhonghao plans to construct the project with a Hong Kong-based listed company, he said.
He declined to identify any potential partner or provide a schedule for the project.
